implementation: Handwritten high-level C resource operations; no CPU or instruction executor
caller: fx_diagnostic_run_screen in fx_boot_events.c computes the result after two prefix flushes and before the Read caption/ports/final flush

api.resources: Caller-owned write/read status and write/read retention callbacks; all four required before the first operation
api.normal_backend: Actual volatile software resource storage, bound by fx_diagnostic_resource_model_bind
api.return: COMPLETE with A5/00; INVALID and UNAVAILABLE have no firmware failure claim

limits: Software-resource behavior does not certify a physical CPU or arbitrary LTO artifacts.
Only unmodified native success paths executed; failures are separately identified C resource controls.
The status latch is distinct from the original final PSW; arithmetic outside this diagnostic does not use this resource model.
